inputs.name: keycloak_version
inputs.description: Keycloak release to install, such as "26.8.1". Change keycloak_sha256 with it. Raising it installs the new release beside the old one and upgrades Keycloak in place.

inputs.name: keycloak_sha256
inputs.description: SHA-256 of keycloak-VERSION.tar.gz. Change it with keycloak_version.

inputs.name: java_version
inputs.description: OpenJDK release to run Keycloak on, from the distribution's packages: 21 or 25. Fedora 45 packages only 25.

inputs.name: admin_username
inputs.description: Name of the temporary admin Keycloak creates in the master realm on its first start.

inputs.name: admin_password
inputs.description: Password of the temporary admin, set on Keycloak's first start only. Pass it at run time with -var or TF_VAR_admin_password; it never reaches state or the plan.

inputs.name: hostname
inputs.description: Address people reach Keycloak by, as a URL such as "https://auth.example.com" or a bare host name. Keycloak builds its links and token issuers from it. When null, Keycloak takes it from each request, with hostname-strict=false, which is fine for a lab and wrong for anything public.

inputs.name: proxy_headers
inputs.description: Which headers from a reverse proxy Keycloak trusts for the client's address and scheme: "xforwarded", "forwarded", or null when nothing sits in front of it.

inputs.name: http_host
inputs.description: Address Keycloak listens on, for HTTP or HTTPS and its management port. The default keeps it to the host itself, for a proxy in front; "0.0.0.0" listens on every address.

inputs.name: http_port
inputs.description: Port of plain HTTP, used when tls_certificate_file is null.

inputs.name: https_port
inputs.description: Port of HTTPS, used with tls_certificate_file.

inputs.name: management_port
inputs.description: Port of Keycloak's management interface, which serves /health and /metrics.

inputs.name: tls_certificate_file
inputs.description: Path on the host of a PEM certificate chain. When set, Keycloak serves HTTPS on https_port and turns plain HTTP off. The keycloak user must be able to read it.

inputs.name: tls_key_file
inputs.description: Path on the host of the PEM private key of tls_certificate_file. The keycloak user must be able to read it.

inputs.name: postgres
inputs.description: PostgreSQL to keep Keycloak's data in, such as { host = "db1" }. The database and role must exist. When null, Keycloak uses its dev-file database in /var/lib/keycloak, which is for labs and trials only.

inputs.name: postgres_password
inputs.description: Password of the postgres username. Needed with postgres. Pass it at run time with -var or TF_VAR_postgres_password; it never reaches state or the plan.

inputs.name: metrics_enabled
inputs.description: Serve Prometheus metrics on the management port at /metrics. Changing it rebuilds Keycloak.

inputs.name: heap_size
inputs.description: JVM heap, set as both -Xms and -Xmx, such as "512m" or "1g". When null, Keycloak sizes it at 70% of the host's memory.
